overloads.semanticRole: The IMAP New transporter command configures a new IMAP connection according to the parameter parameter and returns a new transporter object.

constraints: The parameter object's .host property is mandatory; all other properties are optional and default as documented (e.g. .port defaults to 993, .connectionTimeOut to 30s, .checkConnectionDelay to 300s).
The .accessTokenOAuth2 and .password properties are consumed for authentication but are not echoed back on the returned transporter object.
The defined connection/check timeouts should be kept lower than the mail server's own timeout, otherwise the client-side timeout has no effect.

The optional .listener property is an Object with up to three named 4D.Function callback slots, each with its own (transporter:Object, event:Object) signature and event-payload shape -- documented as the IMAPListenerOnMailCreated, IMAPListenerOnMailDeleted, and IMAPListenerOnFlagsModified entries in references/4d-command-ir-callbacks.json (event.type is "mailCreated"/"mailDeleted"/"FlagsModified" respectively; onMailCreated also carries event.mailCount, onMailDeleted/onFlagsModified carry event.msgNumber, and onFlagsModified additionally carries event.flags). Not referenced via the schema's single-string callbackContractRef because that field supports only one contract per command, not a multi-slot listener object; cross-referenced here in prose instead.
